title: Once-Only Handler
prompt: Write `once(fn)` that RETURNS a wrapper which calls `fn` with the FIRST invocation's arguments and returns its result; every later call RETURNS that same first result without running `fn` again. `fn`'s `this` need not be preserved.

tests.name: runs the function exactly once
tests.hint: Store both the result and a done flag in the closure.

tests.name: remembers the first arguments
tests.hint: Guard the body with if (done) return result; before doing anything.
